name: irori
description: Gather around one screen. Phones are the controllers. An open-source web game console that anyone can add games to.

scripts.prepare:web: npm run build -w @irori/sdk && node tools/sync-sdk.mjs && node tools/build-registry.mjs && node tools/build-notices.mjs
scripts.build: npm run prepare:web && npm run build -w @irori/web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @irori/edge
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @irori/edge -- --dry-run
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:games
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:tools && npm run test:games
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts && npm run test:e2e:host -w @irori/web && npm run test:e2e:pad -w @irori/web
